subject.title: [Bug]: IRC channel reports healthy while dead-looping reconnects on a non-recoverable login error

question: For IRC post-ready reconnect failures caused by fatal login replies 432, 464, or 465, should the monitor mark the account terminally failed, or keep retrying with capped backoff while publishing connected:false and lastError?
rationale: Both choices are plausible: terminal failure is clearer for truly fatal login errors, while capped retry lets an operator fix a server-side password, ban, or nick issue without restarting OpenClaw.

options.title: Capped retry with honest status
options.body: Keep retrying with bounded backoff and publish disconnected/error status so operators see the outage while recoverable server-side fixes can take effect.

options.title: Terminal fatal disconnect
options.body: Treat 432/464/465 on reconnect as a terminal account failure, stop reconnecting, and require operator action before the account runs again.

options.title: Status-only first slice
options.body: First land disconnected/error status for the current loop, then decide the retry/backoff policy in a follow-up.

recommendation.title: Capped retry with honest status
recommendation.body: Keep retrying with bounded backoff and publish disconnected/error status so operators see the outage while recoverable server-side fixes can take effect.

likelyOwner.reason: He validated and merged the adjacent IRC lifecycle PR and is the clearest history-backed owner for the remaining policy choice.
